summary: Frontend-only testing of KineticCourt tennis technique app. Verified homepage hero, category cards, navbar behavior, forehand page: all 9 hotspots, 3 tabs, save-drill toast, UTR level content switching, all 7 phase timeline pills with cue updates, quick-nav chips, and mobile responsive layout. All ~30 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Forehand.jsx uses AnimatePresence key `${activeId}-${level}-${tab}` which triggers full exit/enter animation on every tab click; rapid programmatic clicks can leave button not immediately visible for ~300ms — minor UX/testing concern only.
No error boundaries; if data ever mismatches (e.g., missing hotspot id), the app would white-screen. Consider adding a fallback.
PLAYER_IMAGE is a single external emergentagent CDN URL — if that host is down, both Home hero and Forehand stage break. Consider bundling as local asset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Hero title, subtitle, Explore Techniques nav, Forehand category card nav, Backhand/Serve/Volley coming-soon toasts (both category cards and navbar), Launch Lab nav, all 9 hotspots update telemetry title, 3 tabs work, save-drill-btn shows success toast ('Drill saved · Hip Coil · UTR 1–2'), UTR level selector changes body text between utr12 and utr46, all 7 phase pills change cue banner text and highlight focus hotspots, chip-<id> selects the corresponding hotspot, and mobile 390px layout loads as single column. No backend calls.
